(3) DRY-RUN ПЕРВОГО ОБУЧЕНИЯ + verify гейта: первый реальный прогон = режим train+compare+печать вердикта БЕЗ авто-промоута, под ревью оператора (Telegram-уведомление с before/after метриками); авто-промоут включить ПОСЛЕ подтверждения. ОБЯЗАТЕЛЬНО verify-by-code что FinetuneGate-фикс (99034ac5) реально корректен — eval сравнивает detection-выходы (не classification probs), метки=имена, gate-on-person-precision, атомарный промоут (literary-slop урок: не доверять «done», проверить что gate реально не пустит худшую).

goal: Enhance the OKO system's object detection capabilities by implementing automated collection of empty/background scenes and establishing a nightly, self-correcting retraining pipeline. This will improve model robustness against false positives and ensure continuous model improvement through automated data labeling, training, and conditional promotion.
constraints: The task is NOT a duplicate of earlier autotrain tasks (which focused on the 5-stage foundation).
Implementation must be modular ('поглавно'), atomic (1 file/test per atom), and verified by `pytest oko`.
Gemini-2.5-flash labeling is permitted during training time.
New models are promoted ONLY if they demonstrate improvement over the current model in `person-precision` AND `accuracy` on held-out data; otherwise, a rollback must occur.
The nightly scheduler must be idempotent (catch up on missed runs).
Live inference must be paused or timeboxed during GPU-intensive training operations.

The first training run must be a dry-run: train, compare, print verdict, WITHOUT auto-promotion, awaiting operator review and explicit confirmation via Telegram notification with before/after metrics.

The FinetuneGate fix (commit 99034ac5) must be explicitly verified by code to ensure it correctly compares detection outputs (not classification probabilities), uses label names, gates on `person-precision`, and ensures atomic promotion.
The system must balance positive examples, empty-negatives, and hard-negatives in the dataset.
Empty scene collection must be periodic (timer-based or every N frames without detection, e.g., 5-10 min).
